model.riskLevelNote: riskLevel is a display label derived from the thermodynamic category; it makes no rate claim
model.tieBreak: exact ties go to the earlier row of the species table (metal, cations, solids, anions)
model.waterLines: E(H⁺/H₂) = -k pH; E(O₂/H₂O) = 1.2288 - k pH, 1.2288 = -dfG(H₂O, NBS -237.129 kJ/mol)/2F
